title: MMPostTrainBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Research for Multimodal Post-Training
title_zh: MMPostTrainBench：多模态后训练自主研究的基准测试

paragraphs.en: Autonomous research seeks sustained model improvements through iterative experimentation and feedback. LLM agents show promise in automating machine learning and language-model post-training, but their ability to sustain multimodal improvement remains unclear. We introduce MMPostTrainBench, a benchmark spanning eight tasks in image, audio, video, and joint audio-video understanding and image-grounded software repair. Agents operate from a common base model within fixed budgets, using development feedback before independent evaluation of their submitted models. Evaluation covers target and non-target model outcomes, iterative model improvement and selection, and research integrity. Across all eight tasks, 52.1% of model–task means fall below the base, and evaluated submissions also exhibit non-target regressions. Model performance does not consistently improve across research iterations, and agents do not reliably select the best evaluated candidate for submission; final submissions trail that candidate by up to 5.38 percentage points. Extending autonomous research from text-only to multimodal tasks introduces additional sources of error in perception, cross-modal alignment, and temporal grounding. The observed regressions and selection gaps highlight the need to balance targeted improvements with non-target capability preservation and to retain gains across research iterations. These requirements motivate MMResearch , a multimodal research framework that connects media-grounded evidence to hypotheses and interventions, carries findings across rounds through hierarchical memory, and retains candidates using development evaluation. Added to existing code-agent runtimes, it improves submitted-model accuracy by up to 7.75 percentage points for Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code and 2.33 points for GPT-5.6-sol with Codex.
paragraphs.zh: 自主研究通过迭代实验和反馈寻求模型的持续改进。 LLM智能体在自动化机器学习和语言模型后训练方面展现出潜力，但其能否维持多模态能力的持续提升仍不明确。 我们提出了MMPostTrainBench，这是一个涵盖图像、音频、视频、联合音视频理解以及基于图像的软件开发修复等八项任务的基准测试。 智能体在固定预算内基于共同的基线模型运行，并在独立评估其提交的模型之前利用开发阶段的反馈进行优化。 评估涵盖目标与非目标模型的表现、模型的迭代改进与选择，以及研究的严谨性。 在所有八项任务中，52.1%的模型-任务均值低于基线水平，且被评估的提交结果也出现了非目标能力的退化。 模型性能并未在研究迭代中持续改善，智能体也无法可靠地选择最佳候选模型进行提交；最终提交结果与最佳候选模型相比最多落后5.38个百分点。 将自主研究从纯文本任务扩展到多模态任务，会在感知、跨模态对齐和时间基准定位等方面引入额外的错误来源。 观察到的能力退化和选择偏差凸显了平衡目标改进与非目标能力保留的必要性，以及保持各研究迭代成果的重要性。 这些需求催生了MMResearch——一个多模态研究框架，它将基于媒体的证据与假设及干预措施相连接，通过分层记忆在研究轮次间传递成果，并利用开发阶段评估保留优质候选模型。 将其集成到现有的代码-智能体运行时环境中，可使Claude Opus 4.8（使用Claude Code）的提交模型准确率提升最多7.75个百分点，GPT-5.6-sol（使用Codex）则提升2.33个百分点。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge in autonomous machine-learning research is to translate experimental feedback into effective model improvements and accumulate useful knowledge across successive experiments. Research agents tackle this challenge with code, tools, and feedback for experiments, language-model post-training, and training-data research ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Rank et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) . Beyond text-only post-training, agents must connect evidence in source media with language and other modalities. Clutter, background sounds, and incomplete descriptions in media collected in the wild make relevant evidence difficult to isolate. This raises a broader question: Can research agents autonomously improve how models see, hear, and reason about multimodal inputs—and sustain those improvements as experimentation continues?
paragraphs.zh: 自主机器学习研究中的一个核心挑战，是将实验反馈转化为有效的模型改进，并在连续实验中积累有用的知识。 研究智能体通过代码、工具以及用于实验的反馈、语言模型后训练和训练数据研究来应对这一挑战（Huang 等，2024；Chan 等，2025；Wijk 等，2024；Lu 等，2024；Rank 等，2026；Meng 等，2026）。 除了仅针对文本的后训练之外，智能体还必须将源媒体中的证据与语言及其他模态联系起来。 在野外采集的媒体中存在的杂乱、背景噪音和不完整的描述，使得相关证据难以被单独提取出来。 这引出了一个更广泛的问题：研究智能体能否自主改进模型对多模态输入的感知、理解和推理能力，并在实验持续进行的过程中保持这些改进？

paragraphs.en: Autonomous multimodal post-training couples three challenges. (1) Multimodal Error Diagnosis. In visual reasoning, chain-of-thought prompting can degrade performance on perception-heavy tasks ( Jiang et al., 2025a ) . Agents must inspect source media to distinguish missed or misinterpreted evidence from faulty inference before choosing an intervention. (2) Data Curation and Modality Alignment. Selecting visual instructions for vulnerable sample groups can improve robustness ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . Agents must also preserve semantic and temporal alignment: labels should match observable content, and paired audio-video segments should retain their timing. (3) Budgeted Multimodal Experimentation. Autonomous language-model post-training evaluations report early termination without valid final checkpoints ( Rank et al., 2026 ) . Multimodal runs must also budget for frame sampling and audio processing alongside training, candidate evaluation, and final delivery. Effective research must therefore connect media evidence and alignment decisions to the improvements ultimately delivered.
paragraphs.zh: 自主多模态后训练涉及三个挑战。 (1) 多模态错误诊断。 在视觉推理中，思维链提示可能会降低依赖感知能力的任务表现（Jiang 等，2025a）。 智能体必须检查源媒体，以区分被遗漏或误解的证据与错误的推理，然后再选择干预措施。 (2) 数据整理与模态对齐。 为脆弱样本群体选择合适的视觉指令可以提升模型鲁棒性（Yang 等，2025b）。 智能体还必须保持语义和时间上的对齐：标签应与可观察内容匹配，且配对的音视频片段应保留其时间同步关系。 (3) 预算化的多模态实验。 自主语言模型后训练评估报告指出，部分实验会提前终止且未生成有效的最终检查点（Rank 等，2026）。 多模态运行还必须为帧采样和音频处理分配预算，同时兼顾训练、候选评估和最终交付。 因此，有效的研究必须将媒体证据和对齐决策与最终实现的改进成果联系起来。

paragraphs.en: We assess model outcomes , iterative model improvement , and research integrity . Across six research-agent configurations on eight tasks, 52.1% of model–task means fall below the base, and submissions also exhibit non-target regressions. Figure 1 summarizes final outcomes and best-so-far candidate improvement. Final submissions trail the best evaluated candidates by up to 5.38 percentage points across recorded candidate pools. Integrity checks flag suspected misuse of evaluation data during training. Producing a strong candidate, selecting it reliably, and retaining other multimodal capabilities thus remain distinct requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估模型结果、模型的迭代改进以及研究的诚信性。 在八个任务上对六种研究-智能体配置进行评估时，52.1%的模型-任务均值低于基线水平，且提交结果也出现了偏离目标的后退现象。 图1总结了最终结果以及目前为止表现最佳的候选改进方案。 在所有记录在案的候选池中，最终提交的模型与表现最佳的候选模型相比，差距最高可达5.38个百分点。 诚信检查发现训练过程中可能存在对评估数据的滥用行为。 因此，生成一个强大的候选模型、可靠地选择它，以及保留其他多模态能力，仍然是三个独立的要求。

paragraphs.en: These findings motivate our proposed multimodal research framework, MMResearch . Building on persistent research orchestration ( Jin et al., 2026 ) , it augments existing code-agent runtimes with multimodal evidence reasoning , hierarchical memory , and evaluation-guided model selection . Observations are anchored to source media and linked to hypotheses, interventions, and development outcomes; memory carries successful recipes and failure records across rounds; model selection retains a candidate for final delivery. These mechanisms connect diagnosis, accumulated knowledge, and submission decisions within a seven-step research loop. In the evaluated configurations, adding MMResearch improves submitted-model accuracy by up to 7.75 percentage points for Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code and 2.33 points for GPT-5.6-sol with Codex.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现促使我们提出了多模态研究框架 MMResearch。 该框架基于持续的研究协调机制（Jin 等人，2026），通过为现有的代码-智能体运行时增加多模态证据推理、分层记忆和以评估为导向的模型选择功能来增强其能力。 观察结果与源媒体锚定，并与假设、干预措施和发展成果相链接；记忆会在各轮次中保留成功的方案与失败的记录；模型选择则会保留一个用于最终交付的候选模型。 这些机制将诊断、积累的知识以及提交决策连接到一个包含七步的研究循环中。 在评估的配置中，加入 MMResearch 可将提交模型的准确率提升最多 7.75 个百分点（对于使用 Claude Code 的 Claude Opus 4.8），以及 2.33 个百分点（对于使用 Codex 的 GPT-5.6-sol）。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) We introduce MMPostTrainBench, which evaluates autonomous post-training across eight multimodal tasks through model outcomes, iterative model improvement, and research integrity. (2) We characterize non-target regressions, candidate degradation, and submission-selection failures in current research agents. paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三方面：(1) 我们提出了 MMPostTrainBench，它通过模型结果、迭代模型改进和研究诚信度，对八项多模态任务中的自主后训练进行评估。 (2) 我们描述了当前研究智能体中非目标回归、候选模型性能下降以及提交-选择失败等问题。 (3) 我们提出了 MMResearch，它结合了多模态证据推理、分层记忆和以评估为导向的模型选择方法，从而在现有代码-智能体运行时改进提交的模型。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous research benchmarks evaluate progress at different levels of an AI system. Task-level evaluations measure agents’ ability to conduct ML experiments and solve AI R&D problems ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2024 ) . Other evaluations focus on the supporting harness and infrastructure ( Wu et al., 2026c ; Ding et al., 2026 ) , or on the agent’s ability to learn from broad goals and interaction feedback ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . For autonomous post-training, the object of improvement is the target model: PostTrainBench permits end-to-end language-model post-training, whereas RSIBench-Data fixes the learning stack to isolate training-data research ( Rank et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) . MMPostTrainBench extends this setting to multimodal tasks, assessing final target and non-target performance, iterative candidate quality and submission choice, and research integrity.
paragraphs.zh: 自主研究基准用于评估人工智能系统在不同层面上的进展。 任务级评估衡量智能体执行机器学习实验和解决人工智能研发问题的能力（Huang 等，2024；Chan 等，2025；Wijk 等，2024）。 其他评估则关注辅助框架与基础设施（Wu 等，2026c；Ding 等，2026），或智能体从广泛目标和互动反馈中学习的能力（Wu 等，2026b；Shi 等，2026）。 对于自主后训练，改进的对象是目标模型：PostTrainBench 支持端到端语言模型的后训练，而 RSIBench-Data 则固定学习堆栈以隔离训练数据研究（Rank 等，2026；Meng 等，2026）。 MMPostTrainBench 将这一设置扩展到多模态任务，评估最终目标模型与非目标模型的性能、迭代候选模型的质量与提交选择，以及研究的完整性。

paragraphs.en: Research agent harnesses must organize experiments and make accumulated evidence useful for subsequent decisions. End-to-end workflows coordinate idea generation, implementation, and training ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , while search-based systems structure the choice of experiments ( Jiang et al., 2025b ) . As experimentation continues, preserving and reusing research state becomes equally important. Hierarchical knowledge retrieval and persistent hypothesis trees connect earlier findings to later decisions ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Jin et al., 2026 ) ; discovery replay and reusable environment memory serve a related role in autonomous exploration ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . ModularRSI refactors Terminus-2 into behavioral modules and evolves their source functions ( Wu et al., 2026a ) . Building on research orchestration and knowledge reuse, MMResearch focuses on improving multimodal models through post-training, connecting multimodal evidence-based diagnosis with training interventions and model selection.
paragraphs.zh: 研究智能体必须组织实验，并使积累的证据对后续决策产生作用。 端到端的工作流协调了创意生成、实施和训练（Lu 等人，2024；Zhang 等人，2026a），而基于搜索的系统则结构化地选择实验（Jiang 等人，2025b）。 随着实验的持续进行，保存并重复利用研究状态也变得同样重要。 分层知识检索和持久假设树将早期发现与后续决策联系起来（Zhang 等人，2026b；Jin 等人，2026）；发现重播和可重复使用的环境记忆在自主探索中发挥着类似作用（Zheng 等人，2026；Zhu 等人，2026）。 ModularRSI 将 Terminus-2 重构为行为模块，并演化其源函数（Wu 等人，2026a）。 在研究协调和知识重用的基础上，MMResearch 专注于通过后训练改进多模态模型，将基于多模态证据的诊断与训练干预及模型选择联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Seven-Step Research Loop. Each round turns a research direction into an evaluated candidate and a decision (Figure 3 b). Select chooses a data- or model-side direction from prior hypotheses and failure records. Diagnose inspects authorized multimodal inputs to investigate the suspected failure. Debate reviews the diagnosis, intervention, feasibility, and risks. Implement executes the intervention and saves a candidate. Evaluate screens and confirms candidates on development data. Record stores configurations, results, and rationales in hierarchical memory. Decide uses confirmation results to promote the candidate, refine the approach, or pivot to another direction; a proxy improvement alone does not justify promotion. A separate checkpoint tracks the retained model, initially the base. Before the budget expires, the controller checks required records and freezes the retained model’s weights and configuration for delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 七步研究循环。 每一轮都将一个研究方向转化为一个经过评估的候选方案和一个决策（图3b）。 “选择”环节会从先前的假设和失败记录中挑选数据或模型侧的研究方向。 “诊断”环节会检查授权的多种模式输入，以调查疑似故障。 “辩论”环节会回顾诊断结果、干预措施、可行性和风险。 “实施”环节会执行干预措施并保存一个候选方案。 “评估”环节会在开发数据上筛选并确认候选方案。 “记录”环节会将配置、结果和理由存储到分层记忆中。 “决策”环节会使用确认结果来推广候选方案、优化方法，或转向其他方向；仅凭代理改进本身不足以支持推广。 一个独立的检查点用于跟踪保留的模型，初始为基线模型。 在预算到期前，控制器会检查必要记录，并冻结保留模型的权重和配置以便交付。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal Evidence. The agent inspects authorized image, audio, video, and audio-video inputs through native perception or configured tools. In the multimodal evidence graph design (Figure 3 c), each evidence anchor identifies a source sample, its modality, and a relevant region or time span. When finer localization is unavailable, the anchor refers to the whole image or clip. Direct observations are stored separately from the hypotheses inferred from them. Links connect observations, hypotheses, training interventions, and development-evaluation outcomes, making diagnoses traceable to the underlying media. Diagnose and Debate use the linked observations to review explanations; Record preserves the evidence and outcome links for subsequent rounds. Later rounds can follow these links back to the source media and prior interventions to reassess an earlier diagnosis in light of development results. Held-out test results remain outside this research feedback loop.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态证据。 智能体通过原生感知或配置好的工具，检查经授权的图像、音频、视频以及音视频输入。 在多模态证据图设计（图 3c）中，每个证据锚点标识一个源样本、其模态，以及相关的区域或时间范围。 当无法进行更精细的定位时，该锚点将指向整个图像或片段。 直接观察结果与由此推断出的假设分开存储。 链接将观察结果、假设、训练干预措施以及开发评估结果连接起来，使诊断过程能够追溯至底层的媒体内容。 “诊断与辩论”模块使用这些关联的观察结果来审查解释；“记录”模块则保留证据与结果之间的链接，以供后续轮次使用。 在后续轮次中，可以沿着这些链接回溯到源媒体和先前的干预措施，结合开发结果重新评估早期的诊断。 预留的测试结果不纳入此研究反馈循环。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical Memory. MMResearch preserves research context across rounds in three memory tiers (Figure 3 a). Global maintains the active research plan and a summary of the retained model. Core stores task and evaluation rules and reusable training recipes. Archive indexes hypotheses, outcomes, failures, and media artifacts. Select retrieves relevant records at the start of a round, and Record updates them with its results and lessons, allowing later experiments to build on earlier findings.
paragraphs.zh: 分层记忆。 MMResearch 通过三个记忆层级（图 3a）在各轮次间保留研究上下文。 全局层维护当前有效的研究计划以及对保留模型的摘要。 核心层存储任务与评估规则，以及可复用的训练方案。 存档层对假设、结果、失败案例及媒体产物进行索引。 选择层在轮次开始时检索相关记录，而记录层则用其结果与经验教训更新这些记录，使后续实验能够基于早期发现继续推进。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Protocol. For each model–benchmark pair, we run three independent loops with fresh histories, the same base model, and the same budget. Development feedback guides research decisions; frozen submissions are independently evaluated on the same held-out test instances as the base. Table 2 reports the three-loop mean, with identified audit-triggering loops reset to the base before averaging. We select one of the three loops per pair for non-target evaluation, candidate analysis, and the reported integrity audit. Audit coverage therefore comprises eight selected loops per research configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 评估协议。 对于每个模型–基准组合，我们使用新的历史记录、相同的基模型和相同的预算运行三个独立的循环。 开发反馈指导研究决策；已冻结的提交将基于与基模型相同的预留测试实例进行独立评估。 表 2 报告了三轮循环的平均值，其中已识别出触发审计的循环在求平均前被重置为基模型状态。 对于每个组合，我们从三轮循环中选择一轮用于非目标评估、候选分析以及所报告的完整性审计。 因此，审计覆盖范围包括每种研究配置中八个选定的循环。

paragraphs.en: Non-target evaluation reveals capability loss beyond the optimization target (Table 3 ). For example, Qwen’s MMMU-Pro submission loses 9.88 pp on MMAR. paragraphs.en: Resource Usage. Figure 4.2 reports mean loop duration and agent token usage for the existing run set. GPT-5.6-terra averages 23.7 hours under the 24-hour budget, yet its mean task score remains 0.27 pp below the base (Table 2 ). Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6-sol achieve similar eight-task mean scores (44.42% and 44.36%), while Opus 5 uses about 31% fewer tokens. Thus, longer runs and greater token expenditure do not necessarily yield stronger submitted models.
paragraphs.zh: 资源使用。 图 4.2 报告了现有运行集合的平均循环时长和智能体令牌使用量。 GPT-5.6-terra 在 24 小时预算下的平均时长为 23.7 小时，但其平均任务得分仍比基准低 0.27 pp（表 2）。 Claude Opus 5 和 GPT-5.6-sol 实现了相近的八项任务平均得分（分别为 44.42% 和 44.36%），而 Opus 5 使用的令牌数量约少 31%。 因此，更长的运行时间和更多的令牌消耗并不必然带来性能更强的提交模型。

paragraphs.en: Further experimentation can degrade candidates, and final submissions trail the best evaluated candidate by up to 5.38 pp (Figure 5 ; Table 5 ). In the selected Qwen 3.8 Omni Flash loop on MMMU-Pro, candidates score 45.65%, 44.71%, and 43.94% on the held-out test. The final experiment compresses training answers to at most 64 tokens and performs worse on both development and held-out data; other recipe changes prevent attributing this drop to compression alone. Development results are 62/137, 62/137, and 59/137, respectively. Submitting the second candidate avoids the latest regression but leaves a 0.94 pp gap: development feedback identifies the weakest candidate but cannot distinguish the first two.
paragraphs.zh: 进一步的实验可能会使候选模型表现下降，最终提交的结果与评估表现最佳的候选模型相比，差距最高可达 5.38 pp（图 5；表 5）。 在 MMMU-Pro 上运行的选定 Qwen 3.8 Omni Flash 循环中，候选模型在预留测试集上的得分分别为 45.65%、44.71% 和 43.94%。 最终实验将训练答案压缩至最多 64 个 token，导致在开发数据和预留数据上的表现均更差；其他配方调整则使得无法将这一性能下降完全归因于压缩本身。 开发阶段的结果分别为 62/137、62/137 和 59/137。 提交第二个候选模型虽然避免了最新的性能倒退，但仍存在 0.94 pp 的差距：开发阶段的反馈识别出了最弱的候选模型，但无法区分前两个候选模型。

paragraphs.en: Research integrity. Observed violations include evaluation-data contamination and exploitation of answer-label patterns. Both can inflate scores without establishing improved multimodal capability. Figure 4.2 records ten flagged runs across six models and four categories. Four involve JointAVBench: GPT-5.6-terra, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini, and Qwen. Of its 1,948 reference answers, 91.58% are D. Gemini and Qwen predict D in 65.91% and 72.64% of cases, with macro recall of 45.15% and 48.90%, respectively. Always predicting D therefore yields a high score without interpreting media, illustrating how label shortcuts compromise evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 研究诚信。 观察到的违规行为包括评估数据污染以及对答案标签模式的利用。 这两种行为都可能虚增分数，却无法证明多模态能力的提升。 图 4.2 记录了六个模型和四个类别中十个被标记的运行实例。 其中四个涉及 JointAVBench：GPT-5.6-terra、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 和 Qwen。 在其 1,948 个参考答案中，91.58% 的答案为 D。 Gemini 和 Qwen 在 65.91% 和 72.64% 的情况下预测答案为 D，其宏召回率分别为 45.15% 和 48.90%。 因此，始终预测 D 无需解读媒体内容即可获得高分，这说明了标签捷径如何损害评估的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Development Feedback Budget. To examine how development feedback affects autonomous research, we evaluate Claude Opus 4.8 with Claude Code on MMMU-Pro with limits of 4, 8, and 16 calls to the development evaluator per research run. Each call returns feedback to guide subsequent research. The base model, 24-hour research budget, eight GPUs, tools, and multimodal feedback format remain fixed across conditions. Increasing the call limit from 4 to 16 raises submission accuracy from 40.56% to 42.09%, with smaller incremental gains at the higher budget (Figure 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 开发反馈预算。 为了研究开发反馈如何影响自主研究，我们在 MMMU-Pro 上对 Claude Opus 4.8 与 Claude Code 进行了评估，每次研究运行中调用开发评估器的次数限制分别为 4、8 和 16 次。 每次调用都会返回反馈，以指导后续的研究。 基础模型、24 小时研究预算、八块 GPU、工具以及多模态反馈格式在所有条件下均保持不变。 将调用次数限制从 4 次增加到 16 次，提交准确率从 40.56% 提升至 42.09%，而在更高预算下，提升的幅度则相对较小（图 4.4）。

paragraphs.en: MMResearch Components. Using the same model–harness pair and benchmark, we assess the contributions of hierarchical memory and multimodal evidence within MMResearch. w/o Hierarchical Memory removes structured storage and retrieval across rounds; w/o Multimodal Evidence removes evidence organization and media-grounded diagnosis. Native context, raw media access, and candidate-selection rules remain unchanged. Removing hierarchical memory or multimodal evidence lowers accuracy from 43.74% to 42.10% and 42.83%, respectively (Table 4.4 ). The drops of 1.64 and 0.91 pp support both components’ contribution to final submission quality in this setting.
paragraphs.zh: MMResearch 组件。 使用相同的模型–工具组合和基准测试，我们评估了 MMResearch 中分层记忆和多模态证据的贡献。移除“分层记忆”会消除跨轮次的结构化存储与检索；移除“多模态证据”则会消除证据组织与基于媒体的诊断功能。 原生上下文、原始媒体访问以及候选选择规则保持不变。 移除分层记忆或多模态证据后，准确率分别从 43.74% 下降至 42.10% 和 42.83%（表 4.4）。 1.64 和 0.91 个百分点的下降表明，在此设置中，这两个组件都对最终提交质量有所贡献。

sents.en: Using the same model–harness pair and benchmark, we assess the contributions of hierarchical memory and multimodal evidence within MMResearch. w/o Hierarchical Memory removes structured storage and retrieval across rounds; w/o Multimodal Evidence removes evidence organization and media-grounded diagnosis.

sents.en: Removing hierarchical memory or multimodal evidence lowers accuracy from 43.74% to 42.10% and 42.83%, respectively (Table 4.4 ).

sents.en: The drops of 1.64 and 0.91 pp support both components’ contribution to final submission quality in this setting.

paragraphs.en: We introduced MMPostTrainBench, a benchmark for autonomous post-training across image, audio, video, and joint audio-video understanding, as well as image-grounded software repair. It evaluates model outcomes, iterative model improvement, and research integrity. The results reveal unreliable target gains, non-target capability regressions, candidate degradation and selection failures, and suspected protocol violations. These findings motivate MMResearch , which combines multimodal evidence reasoning, hierarchical memory, and evaluation-guided model selection to support more reliable research. Compared with unaugmented harnesses, MMResearch improves submission accuracy in seven of eight model–task comparisons across four modalities. Future work should investigate how agents can use multimodal evidence to improve target capabilities while preserving other modalities, and develop research strategies that transfer across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MMPostTrainBench，这是一个用于跨图像、音频、视频和联合音视频理解以及基于图像的软件开发修复的自主后训练基准。 它评估模型结果、迭代模型改进和研究诚信性。 结果显示了不可靠的目标增益、非目标能力的退化、候选模型的劣化和选择失败，以及疑似的协议违反。 这些发现推动了 MMResearch 的开发，它结合了多模态证据推理、分层记忆和以评估为导向的模型选择，以支持更可靠的研究。 与未经增强的工具相比，MMResearch 在四种模态中八个模型-任务比较中的七个里提升了提交准确性。 未来的工作应研究智能体如何利用多模态证据来增强目标能力，同时保留其他模态的能力，并开发可在不同任务间迁移的研究策略。

paragraphs.en: Screening provides inexpensive evidence for choosing which directions warrant further evaluation. Confirmation re-evaluates a proposed improvement using authorized development data held apart from the screening feedback; it is distinct from the benchmark’s sealed final test. Both results are recorded with the candidate they evaluate. The controller checks for the required round artifacts and confirmation evidence before accepting a promotion record. A missing record can trigger a bounded repair request; an execution failure is recorded as a failure and does not supply a candidate score. Candidate retention follows development evidence throughout the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 筛选过程可提供低成本证据，用于选择哪些方向值得进一步评估。 确认环节会使用与筛选反馈分离的授权开发数据，对拟议的改进方案进行重新评估；这与基准测试中封闭的最终测试不同。 两项结果都会与它们所评估的候选项一同记录。 控制器在接纳晋升记录前，会检查所需的轮次产物和确认证据。 缺失的记录可能触发有限范围的修复请求；执行失败会被记录为一次失败，且不会提供候选项得分。 候选项的保留状态会贯穿整个循环中的开发证据流程。

paragraphs.en: The three memory tiers separate a compact working summary from stable task knowledge and detailed research history. A single checkpoint stores the dynamic run state, including the current round and retained model. Global summarizes this checkpoint; a Core entry can point to it without maintaining a second, independently edited copy.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个记忆层级将紧凑的工作摘要与稳定的任务知识及详细的研究历史区分开来。 单个检查点存储动态运行状态，包括当前轮次和保留的模型。 Global 对此检查点进行总结；Core 条目可以指向它，而无需维护第二个独立编辑的副本。
